title: Dura-Europos Church
geometryBasis: The 2008 total-station and photogrammetric survey in Pleiades 888638007 sets the excavated 15-point outline and its street orientation. The nearby named OpenStreetMap point corroborates the identity, independently of the surveyed outline used for placement.
sectionBasis: The Yale–French excavations and recent archaeology establish a mudbrick courtyard building, long converted southern assembly room, western baptistery and west-wall font with plaster canopy, roof stair, flat timber-and-earth roofs and a low attic over the baptistery.
limitations: The model reconstructs the worship phase around 250 CE on the modern surveyed coordinates. Roof edges, secondary doors, exterior paint, partition locations without published dimensions and reconstructed plaster details are approximate.

The basin and canopy follow Pearson’s recorded section. The painted plaster is represented by muted tonal modeling without reproducing the complete mural cycle. Nearby buildings, city walls and the later embankment are outside the selected footprint.
